mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.category_id, f.name, f.description, f.logo, f.href, f.cover, f.thumbnail, f.sort, f.create_time, f.update_time, c.name AS category_name FROM blog_friend f LEFT JOIN blog_friend_category c ON c.id = f.category_id ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.category_id, f.name, f.description, f.logo, f.href, f.cover, f.thumbnail, f.sort, f.create_time, f.update_time, c.name AS category_name FROM blog_friend f LEFT JOIN blog_friend_category c ON c.id = f.category_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_friend (id, category_id, name, description, logo, href, cover, thumbnail, sort) VALUES (#{id}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{logo}, #{href}, #{cover}, #{thumbnail}, #{sort})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_friend WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
